findings.finding: The inner universal is written `\lforall x]`. The macro accepts two optional bracketed arguments, so this supplies neither argument and leaves the x and closing bracket as literal mathematical material instead of binding x over the following matrix.
findings.controlling_evidence: The outer quantifier and the surrounding chapter use the two-argument form `\lforall[variable][matrix]`; upstream/open-logic-config.sty declares `\lforall` with two optional arguments.
findings.required_translation_handling: Change only the inner quantifier to `\lforall[x][...]`, preserve the displayed formula otherwise, and add an adjacent OLTEFOLBYD-001 disclosure.
